title: Automate changelog and onboard mistral-lite-6b v1.0 (metadata + perf profiles)
author: Anya Patel
commits: Add mistral-lite-6b v1.0 metadata JSON and perf profile YAML
Add changelog automation hook to generate onboarding release note snippets
Update registry index and tests to include new model
Fix CI: pin pyyaml and address flake8 lint failures
description: Adds initial metadata and performance profiles for mistral-lite-6b v1.0 and wires the changelog/release notes automation to include model onboarding entries. Motivation: reduce manual steps when adding models and ensure perf profiles are checked into the registry and surfaced to release notes. This change includes a model metadata JSON (schema v1), a perf profile YAML with latency/throughput reference numbers and hardware compatibility tags, an automated changelog snippet generator that consumes perf metadata and appends a standardized onboarding note to changelogs, CI workflow updates to run perf-profile validation and changelog generation, unit tests for the metadata schema, and small docs updates. CI initially failed on linting and a pyyaml version mismatch which were addressed in follow-up commits. Perf profiles were validated in benchmark-lab against the runtime and matched expected latency windows. No breaking API changes are introduced by this PR.
review_comments: Lena Chang: Please add schema_version field to the metadata and bump the schema validator. | Author (Anya): Added schema_version = "1.0" and updated validator unit tests in tests/model_registry/test_metadata_schema.py.

Rajesh Menon: Perf profile looks good but please add the hardware tags for dedicated/dedicated-gpu-nvidia-a100. | Author: Added hardware_compatibility tags and a short note in docs explaining target hardware and expected latency ranges.

Kai Thompson: CI failed on flake8 in generate_onboarding_snippet.py; can you run autopep8 or adjust lint config? | Author: Fixed formatting and added a linter-ignore for the long regex used to parse perf metrics.

Lena Chang: Can we include a smoke test that runs the snippet generator in dry-run mode? | Author: Added a small CI job that runs the generator in --dry-run and verifies output contains model name and perf summary.
release_notes: Onboarded mistral-lite-6b v1.0: added metadata and validated performance profiles (latency and throughput references)
Changelog automation: onboarding snippets are now auto-generated from perf metadata and included in release notes when a model is added
CI: added perf-profile validation and dry-run smoke test for changelog generation
